items.evidence: Log shows 19 µL master mix to A1:G1, 2.5 µL fwd and rev primers pairing A1/A2…G1/G2 to A1…G1, and 1 µL template from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 to A1:G1.
Log shows 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI added to A1:G1 and mixed 3x at 30 µL. Code comments record the 37/65°C incubation, and protocol.pause covers the Zymo clean-up.
Log shows 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3/2/3 µL of frags 2/5/6, 2 µL inserts from A1/C1/D1/G1, and 1 µL enzyme mix into A1:D1 with a 5x mix after each.
Code has protocol.comment for the 30x 37/16°C cycling then 60°C, the Zymo clean-up, ice/heat shock and recovery. Log shows 5 µL assembly moved to cells A1:D1 and 250 µL LB added to each.
Log shows a fresh tip for each primer, template, insert, enzyme, transfer and LB addition. Single-tip multi-dispense is used only for one reagent into wells, as in the reference.

judge.summary: The protocol's simulator log matches the specified volumes, well pairings and step order for PCR, DpnI, assembly and transformation. Manual steps are recorded with comments and a pause. Fresh tips are used wherever different fragments or assemblies are handled.
